editorial.subjectLine: Working smarter with AI + a hackathon awaits
editorial.previewText: Inside: AI lessons from MYOB, community wins, and your invitation to the Aotearoa AI Hackathon this August.

founderNote.heading: A note from our founder
founderNote.bodyMd:
July reminded me why this community matters. At MYOB, we watched women in tech roll up their sleeves and use AI not as a buzzword, but as a practical tool to solve real problems and deliver more value in their teams.

Next month we go bigger. The [Aotearoa AI Hackathon Festival](https://aihackathon.nz/) brings us together for two days at AUT to build AI solutions for the UN Sustainable Development Goals — with free pre-event training so no one is left behind. Whether you write your first line of code or your ten-thousandth there, there is a place for you.

Thank you for being part of this. Keep working smart, and keep lifting each other up.
founderNote.signature: Dr. Mahsa McCauley, Founder & Chair, She Sharp

editorial.recapIntro: Here is what our community got up to in July — one evening, plenty of AI, and a lot of smart problem-solving.

opportunities.title: Volunteer at the Aotearoa AI Hackathon
opportunities.body: We are looking for facilitators, mentors, and helpers to make August's two-day festival at AUT a success. Lend your skills and grow your network.

opportunities.title: Bring your team along
opportunities.body: Partner with She Sharp to champion women in STEM. Explore our corporate sponsorship options and put your organisation behind real impact.

editorial.sponsorThanks: A heartfelt thank you to MYOB for hosting July's Working Smarter evening, and to AUT for partnering with us on next month's Aotearoa AI Hackathon Festival. Your support makes this community possible.

heroStat.label: of NZ job ads now reference AI skills
heroStat.context: Job ads that reference AI skills increased 3.9% month-on-month and now make up 3.3% of total job ads.

newsBite.title: Beyond automation: Why AI is forcing us to rethink how work gets done
newsBite.summary: Businesses that treat AI as a mere efficiency tool risk missing bigger gains from redesigning how work actually happens, argues One NZ's chief executive.

didYouKnow.text: NZ's tech 'skills shortage' is really a skills mismatch — the greatest unmet demand is for senior, experienced people. Mentorship matters.

recapEvents.title: Working Smarter: AI, MYOB, and the New Delivery Landscape
recapEvents.shortDescription: An interactive evening exploring how MYOB teams use AI to work smarter, solve problems faster, and deliver more value — with practical use cases and a hands-on AI problem-solving activity.
